Stage.Description: Environment; separate accounts are recommended for production

CustomDomainName.Description: First-party events hostname in the Route53 zone below

HostedZoneId.Description: Existing public Route53 hosted zone in this account for automatic certificate validation and DNS

AllowedCorsOrigins.Description: Exact browser origins; server-only deployments may leave empty

ResidencyMode.Description: Reject unmapped country groups unless fallback is explicitly authorized

AllowCookies.Description: Forward cookies and permit credentialed browser CORS

EdgeRouterPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Existing customer edge boundary; empty uses the default
EdgeRouterPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

DeploymentPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Optional customer boundary for the StackSet execution role; must permit the documented deployment operations
DeploymentPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

EURegion.Description: Region for the EU country group; empty disables it

EUKmsKeyArn.Description: Regional customer KMS key for EU; optional

EUAuthPluginLayerArn.Description: Immutable regional auth layer ARN; empty disables auth for EU; optional

EUAlarmTopicArn.Description: Regional SNS alarm topic for EU; optional

EULambdaPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Customer ingestion boundary for EU; optional
EULambdaPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

EUFirehosePermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Customer delivery boundary for EU; optional
EUFirehosePermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

USRegion.Description: Region for the US country group; empty disables it

USKmsKeyArn.Description: Regional customer KMS key for US; optional

USAuthPluginLayerArn.Description: Immutable regional auth layer ARN; empty disables auth for US; optional

USAlarmTopicArn.Description: Regional SNS alarm topic for US; optional

USLambdaPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Customer ingestion boundary for US; optional
USLambdaPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

USFirehosePermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Customer delivery boundary for US; optional
USFirehosePermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

APACRegion.Description: Region for the APAC country group; empty disables it

APACKmsKeyArn.Description: Regional customer KMS key for APAC; optional

APACAuthPluginLayerArn.Description: Immutable regional auth layer ARN; empty disables auth for APAC; optional

APACAlarmTopicArn.Description: Regional SNS alarm topic for APAC; optional

APACLambdaPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Customer ingestion boundary for APAC; optional
APACLambdaPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

APACFirehosePermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Customer delivery boundary for APAC; optional
APACFirehosePermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

AuthPluginPassClientMetadata.Description: Pass ephemeral client metadata to the regional auth plugin

AdministrationPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Optional customer boundary for the StackSet administration role; empty creates its scoped default
AdministrationPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

LookupPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Optional customer boundary for the read-only regional output lookup role; empty creates its scoped default
LookupPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Use an existing customer-managed policy ARN, including its path.

IamMode.Description: managed creates scoped IAM roles; preprovisioned uses platform-owned roles and never modifies IAM

AdministrationRoleArn.Description: Existing same-account platform role; required in preprovisioned mode

LookupRoleArn.Description: Existing same-account platform role; required in preprovisioned mode

EdgeRouterRoleArn.Description: Existing same-account platform role; required in preprovisioned mode

ExecutionRoleName.Description: Existing same-account StackSet execution role name (no path); required in preprovisioned mode

EULambdaRoleArn.Description: Platform-owned LambdaRoleArn for EU; required when this group is enabled in preprovisioned mode

EUFirehoseRoleArn.Description: Platform-owned FirehoseRoleArn for EU; required when this group is enabled in preprovisioned mode

USLambdaRoleArn.Description: Platform-owned LambdaRoleArn for US; required when this group is enabled in preprovisioned mode

USFirehoseRoleArn.Description: Platform-owned FirehoseRoleArn for US; required when this group is enabled in preprovisioned mode

APACLambdaRoleArn.Description: Platform-owned LambdaRoleArn for APAC; required when this group is enabled in preprovisioned mode

APACFirehoseRoleArn.Description: Platform-owned FirehoseRoleArn for APAC; required when this group is enabled in preprovisioned mode

IamMode.Description: managed creates IAM resources; preprovisioned uses platform-owned roles without creating or changing IAM

EdgeRouterRoleArn.Description: Existing same-account platform role with its policies and boundary already attached; required in preprovisioned mode

EdgeRouterPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Optional existing customer-managed IAM policy ARN in this account for the Lambda@Edge router permissions boundary; empty creates a role-specific stack boundary.
EdgeRouterPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a customer-managed IAM policy ARN (including any policy path).

DeploymentId.Description: Unique identifier for this customer deployment (e.g. ev-prod-acme)

HostedZoneId.Description: Optional Route53 HostedZoneId in buyer account for automatic ACM DNS validation and alias creation (leave empty for external DNS)

RouterConfigurationVersion.Description: Routing configuration fingerprint; coordinated deployment computes it automatically

ReleaseVersion.Description: Immutable release identifier; changing it publishes a new edge version

DefaultRegion.Description: Default regional origin when residency policy permits

ResidencyMode.Description: Regional routing enforcement policy (fail_closed rejects unmapped/unavailable regions)

PrimaryRegionalOriginDomain.Description: Regional Lambda Function URL domain name for the primary region (e.g. xxx.lambda-url.eu-west-1.on.aws)

EuOriginDomain.Description: Optional EU regional Function URL domain name (e.g. xxx.lambda-url.eu-west-1.on.aws)

UsOriginDomain.Description: Optional US regional Function URL domain name (e.g. xxx.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws)

ApacOriginDomain.Description: Optional APAC regional Function URL domain name (e.g. xxx.lambda-url.ap-southeast-1.on.aws)

AllowCookies.Description: Forward cookies through CloudFront to the regional ingestion origin

WafRateLimitPer5Min.Description: Maximum requests per 5-minute window per source IP at the WAF edge

IamMode.Description: managed creates IAM resources; preprovisioned uses platform-owned roles without creating or changing IAM

LambdaRoleArn.Description: Existing same-account platform role with its policies and boundary already attached; required in preprovisioned mode

FirehoseRoleArn.Description: Existing same-account platform role with its policies and boundary already attached; required in preprovisioned mode

FirehosePermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Optional existing customer-managed IAM policy ARN in this account for the Firehose delivery permissions boundary; empty creates a role-specific stack boundary.
FirehosePermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a customer-managed IAM policy ARN (including any policy path).

LambdaPermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Optional existing customer-managed IAM policy ARN in this account for the Ingestion Lambda permissions boundary; empty creates a role-specific stack boundary.
LambdaPermissionsBoundaryArn.ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a customer-managed IAM policy ARN (including any policy path).

DeploymentId.Description: Unique identifier for this customer deployment (e.g. ev-prod-acme)

IamNamePrefix.Description: Coordinated deployment name prefix; leave empty to preserve generated names on independently managed stacks

EventsBucketName.Description: Optional customer-owned S3 bucket name; empty lets CloudFormation generate a globally unique name

GeoData.Description: Persist coarse country/region derived from trusted CloudFront viewer headers

CaptureIp.Description: Persist raw client source_ip in stored S3 event records

PartitioningMode.Description: S3 partitioning mode (FIREHOSE_DYNAMIC extracts namespace; STATIC_DATE uses static time prefix)

AllowedNamespaces.Description: Comma-separated low-cardinality allowlist of valid S3 partition namespaces (max 32)

DefaultNamespace.Description: Fallback namespace when event omits context.namespace

AnonymousAllowedNamespaces.Description: Comma-separated namespaces permitted when request authentication_status is anonymous

EnforcePluginNamespaceAuth.Description: Enforce that authenticated requests only write to namespaces returned in plugin allowed_namespaces

AuthPluginEnabled.Description: Enable invocation of /opt/bin/event-auth from the customer Lambda Layer

AuthPluginLayerArn.Description: Optional immutable ARN of customer-owned Lambda Layer version providing /opt/bin/event-auth (arm64)

AuthPluginPassClientMetadata.Description: Pass ephemeral source_ip and coarse geo to /opt/bin/event-auth stdin for access policy evaluation

AllowedCorsOrigins.Description: Comma-separated exact HTTPS origins permitted for browser CORS requests (no wildcard with cookies)

AllowCookies.Description: Forward Cookie header to auth plugin and enable Access-Control-Allow-Credentials

CloudFrontDistributionId.Description: Buyer-account CloudFront Distribution ID permitted to invoke the private Lambda Function URL via OAC

LambdaArtifactBucket.Description: Regional S3 bucket containing the signed Eventing Rust Lambda bootstrap zip artifact

LambdaArtifactObjectVersion.Description: Optional immutable artifact S3 version ID; coordinated releases always pin it

LambdaArtifactKey.Description: S3 object key for the signed Eventing Rust Lambda bootstrap zip artifact

LambdaReservedConcurrency.Description: Reserved concurrent executions for the regional ingestion Lambda

RetentionDays.Description: S3 lifecycle retention period in days for raw event objects

KmsKeyArn.Description: Optional customer-managed KMS Key ARN for S3 and Firehose encryption (leave empty for SSE-S3 AES256)

LogRetentionDays.Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days for ingestion and Firehose logs

AlarmTopicArn.Description: Optional SNS Topic ARN for CloudWatch delivery and error alarms
